mainEntity.name: How much does water-wise landscape design and installation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of water-wise landscape design and installation is highly variable, depending on factors such as project scope, size of the area, chosen materials, and plant selection. A basic design for a smaller yard might start from a few thousand dollars, while a comprehensive design and installation for a larger property, including hardscaping and advanced irrigation systems, can range from $15,000 to well over $50,000. We provide detailed proposals after understanding your specific needs and site conditions during the consultation phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for water-wise landscaping vary widely based on project scope, size, and materials, from a few thousand dollars for small designs to over $50,000 for large-scale projects.
